name: Wallfahrtsort Mariastein
kurzbeschreibung: The historic pilgrimage site of Mariastein delights visitors as a fortress-sanctuary in the Inn Valley featuring a 42-meter castle tower and the Chapel of Grace.
beschreibung:
Overview

The historic and storied Pilgrimage Site of Mariastein perches dramatically upon an isolated rocky limestone cliff in the Tyrolean Unterland between Kufstein and Wörgl. The prominent architectural landmark of the site is a formidable 14th-century tower castle featuring a forty-two-meter-high keep originally built by the Lords of Freundsberg for military border defense. During the 18th century, following a documented Marian miracle, the military citadel transformed into one of the most visited and revered Marian pilgrimage shrines in all of Tyrol. The spectacular Chapel of Grace located on the uppermost floor of the tower magnetically draws tens of thousands of pilgrims and culture lovers each year.

Route & Requirements

From the base of the fortified rock, visitors pass through a historic timber portal and climb the one hundred and fifty steep stone steps of the famed „Holy Stairway“ (Heilige Stiege) ascending inside the tower. Reaching the top, one enters the reverent tower chapel enshrining the late-Gothic miraculous image of the Virgin Mary dating from the 15th century. On the way down, the Castle Museum in the magnificent Knights' Hall showcases original treasures, including the historic Tyrolean Archducal Crown and imperial scepter. Ascending the stone stairs requires basic surefootedness, aided by sturdy handrails. Comfortable walking shoes are entirely adequate for the tour.

Visit & Arrival

The Chapel of Grace and pilgrimage areas open reliably every day year-round from 08:30 to 17:30 (extended to 18:30 during the summer months). Admission to the chapel is free; a small preservation fee of approx. €3.50 is charged for the Castle Museum. Public transport: regional VVT buses run directly from Wörgl or Kufstein railway stations to the Mariastein Wallfahrtskirche bus stop. Motorists take the A12 Inntal motorway (exit Wörgl Ost or Kufstein Süd) and follow rural signs to Mariastein, where ample free parking is available below the castle cliff.

Tips

From the tall tower windows of the Chapel of Grace, enjoy a breathtaking panoramic vista spanning across the sunny Inn Valley to the craggy limestone peaks of the Kaisergebirge mountains. After visiting the sanctuary, stop at the traditional Gasthof Mariasteinerhof to sample Tyrolean cheese dumplings or venison dishes. A peaceful walk along the forested Mariensteig trail pleasantly concludes the day.
preis: Sanctuary free; Castle Museum and Knights' Hall approx. €3.50
